title: Dévissage des complexes ½ simpliciaux ∂ - parfaits et structures multiplicatives… (1975 ou 1976) : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting, from cote 137 and the neighbouring pages. P is a k-additive category with a distinguished class Σ of short exact sequences, in effect an exact structure in Quillen's sense. P contains objects Φ^i. The functor L ↦ L. = Hom(Φ^·, L) sends P to chain complexes of k-modules; Φ^n acts like a representing object for 'degree n'. There is also a Σ-resolution 0→Z^0=Ψ^0→C^0→C^1→… of an object.

This page splits the resolution into Σ-exact pieces 0→Ψ^i→C^i→Ψ^{i+1}→0. The hypothesis is that L. sends Ψ^i to k placed in degree i. Modern model: degreewise-split exact sequences of bounded complexes of free k-modules.
- Ψ^i = the 'sphere' S^i, i.e. k in degree i.
- Φ^n = the 'disk' D^n, i.e. k→k in degrees n, n−1. Hom(D^n, L) = L_n.
- C^i = D^{i+1}, the cone of the identity of S^i, which gives 0→S^i→D^{i+1}→S^{i+1}→0.

Grothendieck computes all Hom's among the Φ's and Ψ's: Φ→Ψ, Ψ→Φ and Ψ→Ψ (Φ→Φ being already known). He concludes that on the full subcategory P_1 of finite sums of Φ^i and Ψ^j, L ↦ L. is fully faithful. Its essential image is the finite chain complexes with L_i, Z_i, B_i free of finite type.

He then remarks that (P_1, C^·, Ψ^·, ε, ΣP_1) is universal: a k-additive category with such a Σ-structure and a Σ-resolution of an object Z^0. In other words, bounded complexes of finite free modules (sums of disks and spheres) form the free exact category on an infinite resolution.

Next he adds axiom d): Σ-exact sequences admit pushouts along any map out of the sub-object and pullbacks along any map into the quotient (a margin note says one of the two suffices). The next page adds:
- existence of kernels of maps that are surjective on all Hom(Φ^i, −);
- axiom e): every object is an iterated extension of Ψ^i's, with a canonical increasing filtration.
With these he derives a recognition theorem. L ↦ L. is fully faithful on all of P, with essential image the finite complexes with L_i, Z_i, B_i, H_i free of finite type.

Purpose: to recognize abstractly (axiomatically) the category of perfect / free complexes. This would serve the 'dévissage' of ½-simplicial ∂-perfect complexes and their multiplicative structures named in the folder title.
errors: On this page the essential image is described by L_i, Z_i (written Σ_i), B_i free of finite type. Over a general ring k this is insufficient: e.g. k = Z, a complex Z→Z given by multiplication by 2 has Z, B free but is not a sum of disks and spheres. One also needs H_i free (B_i ⊂ Z_i split). Grothendieck adds H_i on the next page, so the gap is corrected there.

Full faithfulness on P_1 is asserted from 'easily found' Hom computations without detail. This is correct in the model (Yoneda for disks plus the sphere computations), but the abstract case relies on the hypotheses identifying Hom's among Φ, Ψ, which are only sketched.

ideas.what: Splitting a resolution into short exact sequences of 'syzygies' Ψ^i, with Ψ^i ↦ k[i], i.e. spheres and disks in chain complexes
ideas.modern_name: disk/sphere complexes D^n, S^n; cone sequence S^n→D^{n+1}→S^{n+1}
ideas.usually_credited_to: folklore (homological algebra; cf. Hovey's model categories for the disk/sphere language)

ideas.what: Functor L ↦ Hom(Φ^·, L) from an exact category to chain complexes, fully faithful on sums of Φ's and Ψ's, with essential image complexes having free L_i, Z_i, B_i (H_i)
ideas.modern_name: representing degree-n by projective-injective disk objects; sums of disks and spheres = complexes with free homology and boundaries
ideas.usually_credited_to: folklore; cf. Keller's work on chain complexes and Frobenius/exact categories (1990)

ideas.what: The category of finite free complexes (sums of disks and spheres) with its Σ-exact structure is universal among k-additive Σ-categories equipped with a Σ-resolution of an object
ideas.modern_name: universal/free exact (Frobenius) category generated by a resolution; universal property of Ch^b(free)
ideas.usually_credited_to: not standardly stated; related universal properties of derived/homotopy categories via dg/derivator theory (Tabuada, Cisinski, Keller) are later and differently formulated

ideas.what: Axiom d): existence of pushouts/pullbacks of admissible sequences; next page: kernels of Φ-surjective maps and dévissage by Ψ's with canonical filtration, yielding a recognition theorem for perfect complexes
ideas.modern_name: Quillen exact category axioms plus a recognition theorem (generators + dévissage)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Quillen (1973) for exact categories; recognition theorems à la Gabriel–Popescu/Morita in other settings

missed.claim: An axiomatic recognition of the category of bounded complexes of finite free k-modules with free homology. It is presented as a k-linear exact category with objects Φ^i (disks) and an infinite Σ-resolution with syzygies Ψ^i ↦ k[i], satisfying pushout/pullback and dévissage axioms. It is also described as the universal k-additive exact category carrying a resolution of an object.
missed.quote: la cat. k-additive est universelle pour une [cat.] Σ ... munie d'une Σ-résolution d'un objet Z^0
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Universal properties of categories of complexes are now usually phrased at the dg/∞ level (free stable ∞-category on one object, Morita theory). An exact-category/Frobenius-level universal property of Ch^b(free) via 'free exact category on a resolution' is not a standard statement. It fits Grothendieck's broader program (derivators, Pursuing Stacks) of characterizing homological structures by universal properties.

missed.claim: This recognition theorem was meant as a tool for the dévissage of ½-simplicial ∂-perfect complexes with multiplicative structures (folder title). The intended application, a universal description of the multiplicative structure, is not carried out here.
missed.quote: On va maintenant supposer de plus d) Pour toute suite Σ-exacte de P ...
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Could connect to semi-simplicial/dg models of perfect complexes and E∞/multiplicative structures on them, but its content beyond the routine recognition statement cannot be judged from this page.

deep.surprise_reason: The mathematics (disks/spheres, Yoneda, sums of disks and spheres ↔ complexes with free homology) is routine. The framing as a universal exact category on a resolution, plus a recognition theorem for perfect complexes, is a nice unpublished perspective not standard in the literature, but modest.
transcription_corrections: 'Ψ^i = k plein en degré i' should read 'Ψ^i. = k placé en degré i' (the image complex is k placed in degree i).
'une [?] symbole [?] de suites' is likely 'une kyrielle de suites Σ-exactes'.
'les Σ_i' in the essential-image condition is almost certainly 'Z_i' (cycles), matching 'L_i, Z_i, B_i, H_i' on the next page.
'complexes de chaînes L' should be 'complexes de chaînes L.' (dotted chain complex).
